full_page.content:
c. 1952 May and June
The following is a faithful transcription of a typed and handwritten original by the Servant of God, Fr. Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
Part of a letter to:
Msgr. Edward Casey Part I is lost
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
II P. S. ?
Perhaps rather a new start for above May 2nd. It was not without surprise that I found the foregoing card in the machine when I went with this to start my "Te Deum, (afterwards inserting the "10:15 P. M., etc.) Incidently, I was probably more surprised than disapoin- at not going to Milwaukee. Thank the Lord, I was able to smile at the profference of both. The Vice-Postulator of the cause, V. Rev. Nerius, O. M. Cap. probably found the time too short before start- ing off for Europe and Rome to hold another conference. There is to be a General Chapter in Rome - starting with a triduum of prayer to the Holy Ghost on the 18th for God's holy Grace and guidance. Of course we'd all like to see Fr. Clement of Milwauke retained, D. v. - excepting Fr. Clement himself who has already sent some of baggage back ahead of him to U. S. . He is known to be rather of a retiring disposition - from responsabilities.
June 3rd
Bles'd, praised, Adored be the Sacred Heart of Jesus and next in all things to the Immaculate Heart of Mary our Bl. Mother. Many thanks for your interesting letter last week. I got a mes- sage of yesterday to Jimmy Ryan. I hope it may in some way break the ice for what we hope the holy Ghost may deign to promp you to do. Jimmy must be now about 80. He was next to Kate . . I rec- eived a very interesting letter from Br. Pat yesterday. . . Quite busy and hopeful. Thank be to God. Mildred Conley phoned a few minutes ago from Chicago quite some details about Neil and Gene- vieve's going to Europe.
Now I'll try to get this of -- about time for the pickup.
Sincerely your Brother Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
Bles'd be God!
